bns:Component.name: Get_ErrorCodeRegistry_ByCode_V2
bns:Component.bns:description: Database V2 Standard Get for Central_Error_Handler's error_code_registry lookup (error_code -> error_category, retryable), per decision #2 (classify by reference table, not message-text parsing). RETRYABLE cast to literal 'true'/'false' via CASE WHEN to remove driver-stringification ambiguity. Defensively wrapped in UNION ALL + outer TOP 1 so a lookup miss still returns exactly one row (falls back to TECHNICAL/false) instead of zero, which would otherwise silently halt the process (stopProcessingIfZeroDocuments) before it can route to the queue-for-manual-intervention path. T-SQL translation of the prior MySQL profile (script_create_framework.sql / EDV_INTEGRATION.ERROR_CODE_REGISTRY). | built with boomi-companion v1.0.57

field.value: SELECT TOP 1 error_category, CASE WHEN retryable = 1 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END AS retryable FROM ( SELECT ERROR_CATEGORY AS error_category, RETRYABLE AS retryable, 1 AS prio FROM EDV_INTEGRATION.ERROR_CODE_REGISTRY WHERE ERROR_CODE = $ERROR_CODE UNION ALL SELECT 'TECHNICAL', 0, 2 ) AS lookup ORDER BY prio
